svg.text: SQLite implementation · 16 tables · 13 JSON-payload tables · 3 relational support tables
Application reference in JSON (not an SQL foreign key)
PK = primary key · FK = foreign key
APPLICATION-LEVEL REFERENCES STORED INSIDE JSON PAYLOADS
Department → users and department-scoped notices/events/exams/career/calendar/faculty/class_notices; career.departmentCodes[] is many-to-many.
User → notices and events (publisherId), class_notices (facultyId), registrations, bookmarks, and notification audiences.
Event → registrations. Bookmark.itemType/itemId → notice, event, career, or a resource embedded in departments.resources[].
class_notices.readByUserIds[] stores reader IDs; notification_reads is the normalized SQL table for notification read state.
All 13 JSON tables also contain created_at and updated_at. JSON references are application-managed and are not enforced by SQLite.
Fig. 1. CampusOne master ER diagram — physical SQLite tables and documented JSON relationships
